The '''Balduran Civil War''' was a conflict that occurred several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The conflict opposed the [[Janissariad]] against another major faction.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|138|Janissariad}}</ref>

As a young man, [[Atour Riten]] fought for the Janissariad during the Balduran Civil War. The experience left him with a distaste for any form of centralized government. Disgusted with politics, Riten decided to become a [[Librarian/Legends|librarian]] and an archivist.<ref name="DS" />

The Balduran Civil War shared its name with the [[Baldur system/Legends|Baldur system]],<ref name="Planetnamia" /> a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Nojic sector/Legends|Nojic sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
